parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL identifier, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by document ChEMBL ID. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Return the results sorted by molecule ChEMBL identifier.
